snippet.title: Tanveer Evan - Door Na Jaa (दूर ना जा) | Official Music Video
snippet.description:
“Door Na Jaa” by Tanveer Evan is a heartfelt expression of love, heartbreak, and the stubborn ache of wanting someone back. It’s about holding on to someone you can’t forget, wishing for one more chance, and hoping they never leave.

Some love stories never truly end. Even when two hearts drift apart, the memories remain, and the longing never fades.


“Tu door na ja, mujhe chhod ke…🖤”


Credits⬇️
Track : Door Na Jaa
Sang, written, & composed by Tanveer Evan.
Music produced, mixed and mastered by ZAYEM at ZAYEM STUDIOS
Starring : Tanveer Evan
Direction : Mushfiqur R. Ayon & ZAYEM
D.O.P : Mehedi Hasan
Lights : Alamgir
Edit & Color : Tasrif Faravi
Production : IgniteFilms

Lyrics: 

[Verse 1]
Ratteya ratteya jaga main tere naal
Kitne raat kitne raat tere saath tere saath
Ratteya ratteya jaga main tere naal
Tu bhi aa tu bhi aa mere saath mere saath

Katu ratteya re, jagu ratteya re
Tere naal rehna si, nal si, nal si
Jag ghum aave, main hu yeha pe
Na jana tere bina kahi bhi kahi

[Chorus]
Tu door na ja mujhe chhod ke
Tu door na ja
Tu door na ja mujhe chhod ke
Tu door na ja

[Verse 2]
Tu bhi aa tu bhi aa mere saath mere saath
Likhoon main kahaniyaan sari raat
Tere saath tere paas rehna hain din raat
Tu hi jaan tu jahaan

Yaad teri aave itni sataave
Bhool na paaye tujhe yaara ye kabhi
Yaad teri aave itni rulaave
Bhool na paaye tujhe yaara ye kabhi

[Chorus]
Tu door na ja mujhe chhod ke
Tu door na ja
Tu door na ja mujhe chhod ke
Tu door na ja

[Verse 3]
Aa chal chalte tere pyaar se phisalke
Mere rooh tak tu aaja tu dhoondle mujhe
Raat bhar yun chalke tere naal duniya rukhve
Mujhe sang tu le sang tu le mujhe sang tu le

Teri bare main sochu main din raat din raat
Yaadon mein basi hain tere khwaab mere saath
Raaton ki khamoshiyaan kaha, haan
Tere saath chal chal chal ve

[Chorus]
Tu door na ja mujhe chhod ke
Tu door na ja
Tu door na ja mujhe chhod ke
Tu door na ja

snippet.title: Mahiya (Official Music Video) Badshah x Shreya Ghoshal - Mahiya ft. Avneet Kaur
snippet.description:
Something very special to my heart is yours now! The collaboration I’ve been waiting for for so long is finally here. Mahiya has always been so close to my heart, and now it’s yours too.
It’s all Shreya Ma’am, Avneet and now YOU!

Give it all the love you can. ❤️

#Mahiya #shreyaghoshal #badshah #avneetkaur #romanticsong 

Audio Credits :- 
➟ Singer : Badshah, Shreya Ghoshal 
➟ Lyrics : Badshah
➟ Composed : Badshah 
➟ Music Produced : Hiten
➟ Mixed & Mastered : Hanish Taneja
➟ Sarangi : Momin Khan
➟ Guitars- Rhythm Shaw

Lyrics :- 
Mahiya Yeh jhumke bindiya chura ke nindiya le jayenge teri,
O piya, tujhe hi dil diya haan kaun iss tarah ho jayegi teri?

Teri aankhein bataye ke tu soyi nahi hai,
Sukoon humko bhi nahi hai,
Mujhe dekh ke shayad lage naa tujhe,
Par aashiq mere jaisa koi nahi hai.
Wajib bechainiyan hai teri,
Mujh mein bhi khaamiyan batheri,
Chahe jahan bhi jau dikhe,
Mujh pe nishaaniyan hai teri.
Joh tu na dikhe toh ye aankhein kis kaam ki?
Zikr na tera toh ye baatein kis kaam ki?
Fikr na kisi bhi baat ki,
Kar tu khaamakha,
Bina raani ke badshah kis kaam ka?

Mahiya Yeh jhumke bindiya chura ke nindiya le jayenge teri,
O piya, tujhe hi dil diya haan kaun iss tarah ho jayegi teri?

Sukoon denge, Sanak denge, Zameen denge, Falak denge
Joh maangega tu haske jaan, tere hanthon me rakh denge.
Bekhabar, rakh thodi si khabar, Kari na jo qadar, hojayegi deri.

Teri parchaayi main banu,
Tanhai main jarun,
Teri aahein main bharu.
Maine maanga tujhe, lagi aake mujhe,
Kisi dua ke jaise tu,
Teri parchaayi main banu,
Tanhai main jarun,
Teri aahein main bharu.
Maine maanga tujhe, lagi aake mujhe,
Kisi dua ke jaise tu,

Rahe na kisi bhi kaam ke,
Jab se bane hain deewane tere naam ke,
Its your boy
jo meri bani hai jaan,
Aave le na chahti jaan meri jaan ke,
Ho jaaye tere...
